You have a problem that is recurrent in nature. Definitely would have responded to the prescribed medications but would have recurred back when stopped.

The other things like face wash which act as adjuvant also would have costed you around 1000/- However, you didn’t seem to purchase it.

Considering the chronic nature of your skin problem, we do recommend antioxidants which are known to help if taken over 3 or more months(clearly mentioned in your prescription). I am not very sure if that was done. 

Now, let’s talk about the treatment recommended. When pts coerced us to provide with solutions that are long term or something that offers better than what has been tried, it’s my duty to put all options on the table. It was ‘suggested’ but “never pushed or forced”. I had given you an alternative which was safer, without long term side effects and found to be effective in my practice. And something people are now opting for in case of chronic problems.

The price of the treatment depends on the consumable cost, which in this case is on the higher side due to the paucity of good, safer and FDA approved alternatives in the market. 

I realise this feedback is just out of frustration and I would really appreciate if you do give us a call back or visit. Some skin conditions are chronic leading to frustration and stress. We understand and we are here to help. 

Dr Yuti Nakhwa

featured_reviews.name: Rashmi Narayan
featured_reviews.review_text: In April 2024, my mother was diagnosed with Bullous Pemphigoid — a severe, rare, and life-threatening condition. As someone raised by a single mother after losing our father in childhood, she is the most important person in my life. Facing such a critical diagnosis left us completely clueless and deeply worried about whether she would recover. By God’s grace, we were connected with Dr. Vaishali, an exceptionally professional, empathetic, knowledgeable, and experienced doctor. She advised admitting my mother under the supervision of Dr. Nilakshi. Together, these two senior doctors — along with their dedicated medical team — played a pivotal role in my mother’s recovery, which happened faster and more completely than we had dared to hope. Given my mother’s age and other health complications, both doctors were extremely careful, cautious, and considerate in their approach. I genuinely felt the personal care they extended towards her. Even though their individual schedules differed, they stayed in perfect coordination, ensuring my mother’s treatment was consistent and well-monitored. Our family is deeply grateful to both doctors for giving us our mother back in better health. She was hospitalized for about a month, followed by routine check-ups. Until May 2025, she remained on multiple medications, immunosuppressants, and half-yearly immunotherapy infusions. From our own research, we understood that recovery from this condition could take 2–5 years, depending on the body’s resilience and the patient’s willpower. My mother’s will was strong, but there were days when she struggled emotionally. On those days, both doctors offered not only medical care but also emotional support, which made a huge difference to all of us. Their approach was well-structured, disciplined, and closely monitored at every step.I also want to acknowledge Zen Hospital for their reasonable hospitalization charges and for having a supportive team that guided us through every process smoothly until discharge.From the bottom of our hearts — thank you, Dr. Vaishali, Dr. Nilakshi, and the entire Zen Hospital team. May you be blessed with health, happiness, prosperity, and longevity, and may you continue serving humanity for many years to come.

How to Protect Sensitive Skin from Peeling During Winter

During winter, skin with sensitivity can get irritated and become very dry and flaky. *What is Ultrasonic Lipolysis and RF Therapy?*

Ultrasonic lipolysis, also known as ultrasound cavitation (U-Lipo), is a non-invasive cosmetic procedure that uses low-frequency sound waves to break down fat cells in specific body areas. When combined with radiofrequency (RF) therapy, the procedure helps tighten the skin in the treatment area.

*How U-Lipo and RF Therapy Work*

- *Ultrasonic Cavitation*: A handheld device applies low-frequency ultrasound waves to the treatment area, causing microscopic bubbles to form within fat cells, breaking them apart and liquefying them.
- *Radiofrequency (RF) Therapy*: RF energy is applied to heat the deeper layers of the skin, causing existing collagen fibers to contract and stimulating the production of new collagen.

*Benefits of the Procedure*

- *Non-invasive*: No surgery, injections, or anesthesia required.
- *Reduced Downtime*: Return to normal activities immediately after treatment.
- *Targeted Fat Reduction*: Focuses on specific areas with stubborn fat deposits.
- *Improved Body Contour and Skin Tone*: Reshapes the body and reduces cellulite appearance.


*Who is a Good Candidate?*

- Close to ideal body weight with localized fat pockets or cellulite.
- In good overall health.
- Seeking a non surgical alternative to liposuction

*What is EMS Sculpting and Contouring?*

EMS Sculpting and Contouring is a non-invasive body contouring treatment that uses a combination of radiofrequency (RF) heating and high-intensity focused electromagnetic (HIFEM) technology to simultaneously build muscle and reduce fat.

*How EMS Sculpting and Contouring Works*

- *RF Energy*: RF energy is used to heat fat cells, causing them to be destroyed and eliminated by the body over time.
- *HIFEM+ Energy*: HIFEM+ energy induces supramaximal muscle contractions, forcing muscles to work at a level far beyond what can be achieved during a regular workout.

*Benefits*

- *Simultaneous Fat Reduction and Muscle Building*: Works on both fronts at the same time.
- *FDA-Cleared*: An approved and cleared medical device.
- *Non-Invasive*: No surgery, incisions, or anesthesia required.
- *No Downtime*: Resume daily activities immediately after treatment.
- *Treats Multiple Areas*: Can be used on areas like the abdomen, buttocks, thighs, arms, and calves.

*What to Expect*

- *Treatment*: A typical protocol involves four 30-minute sessions scheduled 5-10 days apart.
- *Sensation*: Intense muscle contractions and a heating sensation, comparable to a hot stone massage.
- *Results*: Results may become visible after the final treatment, with most significant results appearing about three months after the last session.

*What is EMS Face?*

EMS Face is a revolutionary, non-invasive cosmetic treatment that uses High-Intensity Facial Electromagnetic Stimulation and radiofrequency (RF) to stimulate facial muscles and collagen production, resulting in a natural-looking facelift.

*How it Works*

- *High-Intensity Facial Electromagnetic Stimulation*: Targets and contracts the motor nerves of facial muscles, leading to muscle toning and a more defined facial structure.
- *Radiofrequency (RF)*: Synchronized RF technology gently warms the skin to a therapeutic temperature, stimulating new collagen and elastin growth, and resulting in smoother, firmer skin.

*Benefits*

- *Non-Surgical*: A safe and effective alternative to surgery, with no needles, incisions, or anesthesia required.
